notes.title: March 2021 Hotfix Update
notes.content: Addresses an issue where the music is no longer playing during missions on the remastered version of the game.

notes.title: April 2020 Update
notes.content: This game now supports 64 bit Mac OS X as well as addresses other issues for both Mac OS X and Windows.

notes.title: Compatibility Patch Update
notes.content: Minor bug fixes and optimized performance, including support for the Macintosh.

notes.title: CD-ROM Collector's Editions Now Available (and Win10 fixes too!)
notes.content:
Hi Star Wars fans! 

In honor of Star Wars Day tomorrow, we're happy to announce that the CD-ROM Collector's Editions of [b][i]X-Wing[/i][/b] and [b][i]TIE Fighter[/i][/b] are now available!  So if you own either game already, you  now own the respective Collector's Edition too.  (You may need to restart Steam and/or download the latest update for the title for it all to work properly).  We also pushed out patches that should address issues some users have been having running [b][i]X-Wing[/i][/b], [b][i]TIE Fighter[/i][/b], [b][i]X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter[/i][/b], and [b][i]Galactic Battlegrounds[/i][/b] on Win10.

We love all these games as much as you do.  We're committed to making our great catalog of Star Wars, Lucas adventure, and Disney/Pixar titles available and running smoothly everywhere our fans are. 

May the Fourth Be With You! 

- The Disney Big Picture Team
